_comment: Pinned third-party JavaScript, committed to the repo instead of loaded from a CDN.
Rationale: keeps the CSP at script-src 'self' (no widening), and stops a third party
from learning that a user opened a PDF. The cost is that these files do NOT update
themselves — they parse untrusted input, so they must be reviewed on a schedule.

packages.name: pdf-lib
packages.role: PDF structural manipulation (read + write). Used for every operation that produces an output file.
notes: 1.17.1 is the newest published release; upstream has been quiet since 2021.
Because it is unmaintained AND parses untrusted files, all parsing happens in the
browser tab only — there is no server-side path that feeds it user input.

packages.name: pdfjs-dist
packages.role: Thumbnail rendering only. Never participates in writing an output file.
notes: The 'legacy' build is used: same code, transpiled for a wider browser baseline.
ES modules, so no bundler and no build step are required.
Worker is loaded same-origin from /static/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs, which
keeps pdf.js off its cross-origin blob: fallback (see DEVELOPMENT.md).
